integrity: Complete self-contained proof and reproducibility code, without external certification; source publication chronology verified from arXiv v1.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem covers full-dimensional orthogonal boxes in Euclidean three-space for the probability-normalized even projection mean-section operator. The 1998 Goodey article was accessible only at abstract level; historical overlap cannot be ruled out. Numerical hull checks are corroboration only; the universal claim has an analytic proof. No claims about non-box bodies.
title: Exact mean-section-body volumes and cubical stability for rectangular boxes
